content:
Nuevo Laredo has opened applications for its professional degree scholarship program, a municipal grant that helps students cover the costs of completing their professional degree requirements.

According to CML Noticias, registration is free and done online through the municipal government's official portal. Applicants will need a birth certificate, current official identification, and proof from their educational institution that they meet the requirements to pursue their professional title.

Results will be available starting November 18, 2026, and can be checked with the folio number generated during registration. Applications are evaluated against the program's criteria and available budget, so applying does not guarantee the award.

Those who need guidance can visit the Dirección de Educación at Héroe de Nacataz 3200 in the city center, or call (867) 711 35 05, Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

The degree scholarship is part of the municipal government's student support programs, which also include the Beca de Excelencia and Conéctate al Futuro, an initiative providing free mobile internet to university students. According to the municipal government, more than 54,000 scholarships have been awarded with an investment of nearly 284 million pesos, benefiting students across educational levels.
